name: Stream processing for Mirrored Database change feeds in Eventstream
description: Eventstream now streams change feed updates from Fabric Mirrored Databases, so you can run real-time analytics on operational data without affecting source systems. It supports Mirrored Database sources that expose Delta change feeds.With this capability, you can:- Stream change feed updates from Mirrored Databases into Eventstream.- Build dashboards, alerts, and automated actions with no-code and SQL tools.- Build event driven applications with change data feed.
